name: DOT MD
subtitle: Markdown, math and documents
promotional_text: Edit Markdown, preview equations, and export documents on iPhone and iPad. Optional agents use your configured service, with confirmation before each remote run.
description:
DOT MD is a local Markdown editor for writing and mathematical documents. No DOT MD account is required to edit, preview, save, or export your work.

Writing and preview
• Multi-tab editing, find and replace, undo, and editing history
• Heading outlines, tables, task lists, and syntax highlighting
• Offline LaTeX rendering and a practical subset of flowchart syntax
• Touch layouts for iPhone and iPad, with keyboard and orientation support

Files and export
• Open, save, and share Markdown through the system Files interface
• Recover local drafts when you return to the app
• Export HTML, PDF, and standard DOCX documents
• Configure DOCX fonts, margins, spacing, and editable mathematical equations; complex formatting may vary by output and reader

Optional agents
Configure a compatible service endpoint, model, and API key for editing, proofreading, summaries, or multi-step workflows. All agents are disabled by default. Each remote run requires confirmation of its recipient and scope. Providers may charge for API usage and retain requests under their own policies. DOT MD does not include model credits, and agents are not required for local editing.

Ordinary editing, preview, and export run on your device. API keys are persisted in the system Keychain. External file providers and configured agent services process data according to their own policies.

The app interface is currently primarily in Simplified Chinese. This English product description does not indicate a fully localized English interface.

DOT MD source code is available under the MIT License. Bundled third-party components retain their own licenses.
review_notes:
DOT MD is an iPhone/iPad Markdown editor. Its interface is currently primarily in Simplified Chinese. No DOT MD sign-in is required for local editing, preview, Files integration, or export. There are no in-app purchases or bundled model credits.

Suggested review path: create a document, enter a heading/list/equation, switch to preview, use the 文稿 (Document) menu to save or export, then background and reopen the app to inspect local draft recovery. DOCX settings are available in the toolbar and Document menu.

Optional agents are disabled initially. Configure a service in 文稿 → 设置与 Agent… (Document → Settings and Agents). Every remote run displays the recipient host and scope and requires explicit consent; cancelling does not send the request. Credentials are persisted in Keychain; requests go directly to the configured service. The macOS MCP/CLI helper and Finder extensions are not included in this iOS app.

The maintainer must provide a working, restricted review service and credential privately in App Store Connect before submission. No review credential is embedded in these public files. Please do not treat this draft note as a completed review-access setup.
